name: Files
description: Your files on all your devices, shared with people you choose.

actions.name: files.list
actions.description: List a folder (the root when path is empty). Shared folders appear under Shared/<person>/.

actions.name: files.stat
actions.description: Describe one file or folder.

actions.name: files.read
actions.description: Where a file's content is: its blob hash, and a local path when the folder is kept on this device.

actions.name: files.write
actions.description: Create or replace a file from a blob hash or from text. Pass base (the blob you started from) to detect a concurrent edit.

actions.name: files.mkdir
actions.description: Create a folder.

actions.name: files.move
actions.description: Move or rename a file or folder.

actions.name: files.copy
actions.description: Copy a file or folder (no bytes are copied: the content is shared by hash).

actions.name: files.delete
actions.description: Delete files or folders from all devices. They go to Trash (files.trash_list); trash holds the ids to restore them with files.trash_restore.

actions.name: files.search
actions.description: Find files and folders by name.

actions.name: files.share
actions.description: Share a folder with people (by id or petname), read or write.

actions.name: files.unshare
actions.description: Stop sharing a folder with people (everyone when people is empty). Copies they already have stay with them.

actions.name: files.shared
actions.description: Folders shared with me and folders I share.

actions.name: files.keep
actions.description: Keep a folder on this device (true) or make it online only (false).

actions.name: files.conflicts
actions.description: Files where two devices edited the same version.

actions.name: files.resolve
actions.description: Settle a conflict: keep "this" (the version that has the name), "that" (the other one) or "both".

actions.name: files.send
actions.description: Send files (not folders) to a person, like AirDrop: they are asked, and saved under Received/<your name>/ if they accept.

actions.name: files.sent
actions.description: Files I sent to people and what became of them (sent, saved, declined).

actions.name: files.received
actions.description: Files people sent me: pending, saved or declined.

actions.name: files.receive
actions.description: Save (accept: true) or decline (accept: false) files somebody sent me. send is "<sender>/<id>" from files.received.

actions.name: files.status
actions.description: Sync state of this device and of my other devices.

actions.name: files.sync
actions.description: Rescan the folder and fetch every device's changes now; returns the sync state.

actions.name: files.trash_list
actions.description: Deleted files and folders, newest first, the same on all my devices: one row per deletion (a folder is one row) with where it was, when, from which device, its size and when it leaves Trash. Deletions noticed on disk (rm, another program) are here too.

actions.name: files.trash_restore
actions.description: Put deleted files back where they were (parent folders are made again). A name that is taken gets "(restored)"; to restores into another folder instead. ids are row or item ids from files.trash_list.

ids.description: Trash row ids (a whole deletion) or item ids (one file of it)

to.description: Folder to restore into (empty: My files); default the original folder

actions.name: files.trash_purge
actions.description: Delete Trash rows or items forever, on all my devices: they can no longer be restored.

ids.description: Row or item ids from files.trash_list

actions.name: files.trash_empty
actions.description: Delete everything in Trash forever, on all my devices.

actions.name: files.trash_settings
actions.description: How long deleted files and earlier versions are kept (days, default 30) and how many versions per file (versions, default 10). The same on all my devices. No arguments shows the settings.

actions.name: files.versions
actions.description: Earlier contents of a file, newest first: kept whenever an edit, a sync from another device, a merge or a conflict choice replaced it.

actions.name: files.version_restore
actions.description: Make an earlier version the file's content again; the content it replaces becomes a version.

actions.name: files.version_delete
actions.description: Delete earlier versions of a file forever, on all my devices.
